# NETRA LLM Gateway

> High-throughput, ultra-low latency intelligent gateway and semantic vector caching infrastructure for production Generative AI applications.

## Technical Baseline
- Core Runtime: Java 25 LTS, Spring Boot 4.1.1, Gradle 9 Kotlin DSL on Java Virtual Threads.
- Storage: PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector extension (384-dimension vector index), Redis 8.0 Lua JIT.
- Semantic Engine: In-JVM ONNX transformer models (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) for sub-4ms embedding generation.

## Key APIs
- `POST /v1/chat/completions`: OpenAI-compatible endpoint supporting unbuffered streaming SSE, non-streaming responses, multi-provider failover, and intelligent routing.
- `GET /health`: Health and readiness probe returning service status and version (0.4.0).
- `GET /admin/usage`: Aggregated token counts, spend in USD, and cache hits.
- `GET /admin/logs`: Chronological audit logs for requests and rejections.

## Telemetry Response Headers
- `x-netra-provider`: Upstream provider identifier (e.g. alpha/alpha-small)
- `x-netra-cache`: Cache outcome (hit or miss)
- `x-netra-fallback`: Failover flag (true or false)
- `x-netra-cost-usd`: Precise cost in micro-USD (0.000000 USD; omitted on streaming responses upfront)
- `x-netra-route-reason`: Rationale for model selection (alias, direct model, or classifier score)
- `x-netra-retries`: Upstream retry attempts executed before success (0, 1, 2, 3)
